question_evidence_quote: He drives 37,000 miles every four months.
observed_error: The response uses four four-month periods per year.
error_description: The response converts 9 years into four-month periods using 4 periods per year, although 12 months divided by 4 months gives 3 periods per year. Its multiplication of 9 by 4 is executed correctly, but the incorrect conversion factor inflates the period count and subsequent mileage.
